panels.description: HTF bias pass/fail (conflict or chop detection)
panels.title: HTF Verdict

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  open AS "Open",
  high AS "High",
  low AS "Low",
  close AS "Close"
FROM candles
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND symbol = 'GC'
  AND timeframe = '1m'
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

panels.description: VWAP Deviation (Normalized): Visual zones showing regime-aware price stretch

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  vwap_deviation_normalized AS "value"
FROM features
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND symbol = 'GC'
  AND timeframe = '1m'
  AND vwap_deviation_normalized IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

panels.title: VWAP Deviation
